touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Corwen qualifies as a local detour through Amgueddfa Corwen Museum and Corwen Churchyard Cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Corwen: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Corwen offers Amgueddfa Corwen Museum, Corwen Churchyard Cross, Church of St Mael and St Silien within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Amgueddfa Corwen Museum
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Amgueddfa Corwen Museum and Corwen Churchyard Cross, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Church of St Mael and St Silien
